),

 where activity__is_internal = false
),

 select u.user_id, u.channel, u.signup_date,
       date(u.signup_date + integer '89') as day90
 from users u
),
retained as (
 select c.channel, c.signup_date,
   case when exists (
     select 1 from activity a where a.user_id = c.user_id and a.active_date between c.signup_date and c.day90
   ) then 1 else 0 end as retained_90
 from cohort c
)
select channel, count(*) as cohort_size, sum(retained_90) as retained_90, round(100.0*sum(retained_90)/nullif(count(*),0),3) as retention_pct
from retained
group by channel
order by retention_pct desc;
